newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA sorghum export sales highlights in latest report week:
Sales of 63,800 MT were 34 percent below the previous week, but 32 percent over the 4-week average. The major buyers were Japan (36,600 MT) and Israel (27,000 MT).
Exports of 38,600 MT were nearly four and one-third times the week earlier and 29 percent above the 4-week average. Mexico (26,700 MT) and Japan (11,800 MT) were the destinations.
